question: Where can I find a garden that are within 40 kilometers and lie south of New Mexico Slaughter House, Albuquerque, NM?
sql: SELECT P.park_name FROM parks AS P WHERE P.leisure = 'garden' AND ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 40000) AND ST_Y(P.geometry) < ST_Y(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 )) ORDER BY ST_Distance(P.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 )::geography) ASC;
